dec.pe: Two Russian boys living in Bulgaria with their mother had to pay school fees that Bulgarian pupils did not pay, because of their residence status. The Court found discrimination.
dec.pi: Dua anak laki-laki Rusia yang tinggal di Bulgaria bersama ibunya harus membayar biaya sekolah yang tidak dibayar murid Bulgaria, karena status izin tinggal mereka. Mahkamah menemukan diskriminasi.
